hook: Five people on a boat that was on fire, two miles out.
narration: Five people were stuck on a cabin cruiser, and it was on fire.
They were two miles off Moss Landing, near Monterey, California.
A Station Monterey lifeboat crew pulled right up alongside.
That lifeboat is built to roll back upright if a wave flips it.
The crew held the two boats together in the swell and helped each person across.
[short pause] Smoke was still drifting off the cruiser as the last of them crossed.
outcome: All five made it off, and the crew started towing the boat in as firefighters put out the fire.
title: Boat on fire, 5 aboard, 2 miles out
description:
A Coast Guard Station Monterey 47-foot Motor Lifeboat crew took five people off a 48-foot cabin cruiser that caught fire two miles off Moss Landing, California, on June 10, 2024.
